name: ntumba
description: Accountless provider-direct Bitcoin and Kwacha payment coordination for Zambia.

scripts.check: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn build && yarn test:pwa-assets
scripts.dev: NODE_OPTIONS=--conditions=development concurrently -k -n server,web -c cyan,green "yarn workspace @ntumba/server dev" "yarn workspace @ntumba/web dev"
scripts.test: node scripts/repository-baseline.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/noncustodial-architecture.test.ts && node scripts/observability-architecture.test.mjs && yarn workspace @ntumba/domain test && yarn workspace @ntumba/observability test && yarn workspace @ntumba/providers test && yarn workspace @ntumba/server test && yarn workspace @ntumba/web test
